name: Castellfollit del Boix (Spain)
description: Divided per bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, dark green above and yellow below, with two juxtaposed bands along the division, white above red.
history: The flag was approved on 25 November 2008 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 9 December 2008; it reproduces the heraldic colours in bend, the yellow of the castle on red and the green of the box on white, without the figures: an oblong flag of 2:3, bicolour per bend dark green above and yellow below, with two juxtaposed bands, white above and red below, each 1/12 of the height.

features.role: white band above the division, 1/12 of the height
red band below the white, 1/12 of the height
